evidence.detail: The class recognizes <link=...>, </link>, <tool=...> and </tool> tags and exposes tag-kind classification used directly by the live text renderer.

It owns two preallocated 256-entry rs/l/q$a region arrays, registers rendered text spans with source-string offsets plus screen bounds, and hit-tests those regions against Client.hP/hQ mouse coordinates.
On click hit-testing it extracts the registered source substring and invokes Client.c(String), proving link regions carry executable client link/action text rather than passive formatting only.
For tool regions it resolves the cached rs/l/f/a/j/a TooltipContent from the hovered region and submits it through the recovered tooltip overlay/service path.
Client and the central text-render path reset/update the registry each frame and use its hover-change predicate to invalidate interactive rich-text presentation.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the live link/tooltip rich-text interaction registry.

evidence.detail: Each record stores the source String, two substring indexes, four screen-bound integers, one boolean interaction kind, and optional recovered TooltipContent.
Its only behavioral predicate tests x/y against the stored left/top/right/bottom bounds.

When configured as a tool/tooltip region and the source slice changes, it constructs TooltipContent from the registered source substring (capped at 240 characters); link-type records clear tooltip content instead.
The only exact-v308 owner is RichTextInteractionRegistry, which preallocates and reuses the records while rendering <link> and <tool> spans.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for one reusable screen-space link/tooltip span record.
